Ongoing research · PMSM drive

Open-circuit fault diagnosis across 21 switch configurations

I built a three-phase PMSM drive model with SVPWM and cascaded control loops, then examined normalized phase-current features across six single-switch and fifteen double-switch fault cases. Current work focuses on resolving overlap between fault classes.
